whenToUse: Report and list filters on a day, month, quarter, half year or year with is, before, after or between
Due date fields opened from a button into a popover or dialog and committed on Apply
Localized pickers with translated months, a regional date format and a Monday first week

whenNotToUse.when: One day or a from and to span with no period tabs or operators
A date condition sitting beside other field conditions in one query bar
A booking flow that pairs a day with time slots and a confirm step

agentNotes: Period lists run from `minYear` 2015 to `maxYear` 2026 by default, so pass a later `maxYear` to offer next year; `yearRange` alone changes nothing
`onChange` runs on mount and again whenever its identity changes, so pass a stable state setter, never an inline API call
The text field takes typed input such as 2025, Q4 or a full date only when `inputHint` is set; without it the field is read only
